meta_description: Price your own project in under a minute. Pick pages, integrations and features, see the total in your local currency, and download a dated PDF quote.
og_description: Price your own project in under a minute, in your local currency, and take away a dated PDF quote.
configure_your_project_options_below_to: Configure your project options below to get an instant cost estimate. Adjust the discount, select your pages and integrations, and export your quote.
covers_hosting_home_contact_pages_whatsa: Covers hosting, home & contact pages, WhatsApp integration, navigation header with logo, social links footer, T&C & privacy pages, professional design, simple architecture, simple domain, and 6 months of included technical support.
every_5_extra_pages_1_is: Every 5 extra pages, 1 is free — applied automatically.
let_visitors_book_appointments_or_see: Let visitors book appointments or see your availability, for example with Google Calendar.
store_and_manage_your_data_for: Store and manage your data, for example in Google Sheets, a dedicated database or Dropbox. Database hosting costs are handled by Grasshopper.
show_your_location_or_service_area: Show your location or service area on an interactive map, for example with Google Maps.
accept_online_payments_on_your_site: Accept online payments on your site through a payment provider such as a card processor or PayPal. The provider's transaction fees are paid by the client.
smart_features_powered_by_ai_such: Smart features powered by AI, such as a chatbot that answers your visitors' questions. Usage bills from the AI provider are paid by the client.
premium_options_to_boost_your_site: Premium options to boost your site's visibility, reach and support.
help_your_site_appear_in_google: Help your site appear in Google searches and local map results.
get_your_own_professional_web_address: Get your own professional web address. Price may vary depending on the domain.
make_your_website_available_in_multiple: Make your website available in multiple languages for a wider audience.
a_custom_logo_plus_your_brand: A custom logo plus your brand colors and fonts, delivered as a simple brand guide.
sell_products_online_with_a_shopping: Sell products online with a shopping cart and secure checkout. Comes with the Database and Payments integrations, which are costed and added to the budget as extras, plus 7 store pages: shop, product, cart, checkout, payment success, payment failed, and shipping & returns. The pages are included in the price.
mobile_layout_note: Makes your website adapt to phones and tablets. This is not a Google Play Store app or an iOS app.
android_app_note: Your project published as an Android app on the Google Play Store, subject to store approval. The Mobile-Friendly Layout integration is costed and added to the budget as an extra. Store account fees are absorbed by Grasshopper and the app is published under our developer account, unless you prefer your own.
ios_app_note: Your project published as an iPhone and iPad app on the Apple App Store, subject to store approval. The Mobile-Friendly Layout integration is costed and added to the budget as an extra. Store account fees are absorbed by Grasshopper and the app is published under our developer account, unless you prefer your own.
store_setup_note: We set up your own Google Play and Apple developer accounts in your name, so your apps are published under your account. The developer fees are then paid by you and are not absorbed: Google Play $25 one-time, Apple Developer Program $99 per year. For use with the Android or iOS app.
user_accounts_note: Let visitors register, log in and manage their own account. Comes with the Database integration, which is costed and added to the budget as an extra, plus 4 account pages: login, register, forgot password and my account. The pages are included in the price.
your_project_goes_to_the_front: Your project goes to the front of the queue and is delivered in 24-48 hours once we have all your content.
adds_6_months_of_technical_support: Adds 6 months of technical support on top of the 6 included (12 months in total after final delivery), with your requests handled first for the full year.
base_price_is_usd_other_currencies: Base price is USD. Other currencies are converted at the current exchange rate — an estimate, not a locked-in price.
prices_are_indicative_and_may_be: Prices are indicative and may be reviewed or changed without notice. Any budget generated here is valid and will be honoured for 30 days from its creation date.
converted_amounts_are_indicative_only_ba: Converted amounts are indicative only, based on the exchange rate retrieved on the generation date.
estimates_from_grasshopper_it_solutions_: // Estimates from Grasshopper IT Solutions LLC. Actual costs may vary based on final scope.
